name: 🎓 [Pets!] Homework Lifting Simulator
desc:
🚨 Update 1
🐾 Pets! Hatch and raise 15 new pets! Sell your smarts for coins and open eggs to collect the rarest pets in the game!

😱 The teachers in the school have gone crazy! It's your job to get stronger and stop them before they destroy the school.

✏️ Lift your school supplies to gain better grades and become stronger and faster!

🤔 Customize your character's stats to cloak your strength or go all out and be the best student ever!

😈 Evil Teacher Stats:
🚨 HP: 10 Million
💪 Attack Power: 20K to 50K

😈 Defeat the evil teacher and lift to unlock secret OP weights:
🥇 50 Wins = Gold Pencil
🥈 100 Wins = Doodlebob

✅ Join Sugar Brick Games for a permanent X2 bonus and to receive the hourly group rewards!
